arms.control: Existing architecture; CE over three labelled views
arms.consistency: Existing architecture; same CE plus three-view Jensen-Shannon divergence
arms.capacity: Two extra identity-initialized residual blocks; same CE and consistency loss

policy.selection: Lowest new-raw development NLL among eligible epochs; prefer smaller network unless deeper improves raw accuracy by .002 or lowers raw NLL by 2% without lowering correct-at-90 coverage
policy.font_split: Pinned open fonts: NotoSans/NotoSerif/RobotoSlab/Oswald train, Lato diagnosis/development, Ubuntu final synthetic test
policy.diagnostic_split: First 250 validation indices of each class for diagnosis; remaining 250 for selection
policy.preprocessing: Existing production prepare64; annotations and clean pairs are diagnostic/training information only
policy.scope: Fresh synthetic corruptions; not human-labelled real CAPTCHA population data. Baseline and MNIST have historical evaluations.

consistency.objective: Existing architecture; same CE plus three-view Jensen-Shannon divergence

capacity.objective: Two extra identity-initialized residual blocks; same CE and consistency loss
